text.tspan: Share who are worried about vs. share of deaths from terrorism 2022
Respondents who said they worried "very much" or "a great deal". Confirmed deaths, including all victims and
attackers who died because of a terrorist attack.
Share of deaths from terrorism (plotted on a logarithmic axis)

tspan.tspan: Integrated Values Surveys (2024); National Consortium for the Study of Terrorism and Responses to Terrorism (START) (2022)
Where data for 2022 is unavailable, the value from the closest year between 2012 and 2021 is shown instead.
